## #1 — Import Records Reverse-Targeting — ICE 504 (I:9 C:8 E:7)
**Category:** Lead generation (new style)
ImportYeti/Volza show WHO is importing green marble from India right now — including from competitors. Build a list of companies with active green-marble import bills from OTHER Indian suppliers and target them with a switch pitch: "You're already importing Indian green marble. Here's the same stone, one step closer to the quarry."
- **Owner agent:** importer-researcher → email-drafter
- **Success metric:** ≥4 replies from 25 verified active importers in 2 weeks
- **Kill condition:** <2 replies after full sequence to 25 contacts
- **Why it's different:** These aren't cold leads — they're PROVEN buyers of this exact product, mid-habit.

## #2 — WhatsApp Video Walkthrough Selling — ICE 448 (I:8 C:8 E:7)
**Category:** Conversion (new style)
Replace static lot photos with 60-second personalized videos: walk the actual lot with the buyer's name spoken aloud — "Ahmed, this is the section I'd allocate to you." Send via WhatsApp. Video creates presence no photo can; personalization makes forwarding it internally irresistible.
- **Owner agent:** sample-converter + whatsapp-list-builder
- **Success metric:** ≥50% reply rate on 10 personalized videos to Tier 1 ME leads
- **Kill condition:** <20% reply rate after 10 videos
- **Why it's different:** Nobody in the Udaipur export belt does named-video selling. Costs a phone and 5 minutes.

## #3 — Quarterly FOB Price Benchmark Report — ICE 384 (I:8 C:6 E:8)
**Category:** Inbound lead generation
Publish "Indian Green Marble FOB Benchmark — Q3 2026" as a gated PDF. Nobody publishes real prices; every importer wants them. Competitors' customers download it → their emails enter our pipeline. Repeats quarterly = compounding list growth.
- **Owner agent:** content-lead-magnet + pricing-strategist
- **Success metric:** ≥30 email captures in first month
- **Kill condition:** <10 captures in 6 weeks after LinkedIn + email promotion
- **Why it's different:** Radical price transparency as a wedge — turns our biggest taboo into our biggest magnet.

## #4 — Architect Sample Library Seeding — ICE 336 (I:8 C:7 E:6)
**Category:** Lead generation (specification channel)
Ship free 6-variety sample libraries to 25 hospitality-focused architecture firms (Dubai, London, Miami). Architects specify; contractors must buy what's specified. One specification = multi-container order with no price negotiation.
- **Owner agent:** partnership-builder
- **Success metric:** 15/25 libraries accepted + 3 follow-up conversations in 30 days
- **Kill condition:** <8 acceptances (wrong firms or wrong offer)
- **Why it's different:** Sells to the person who never pays — but always decides.

## #5 — Gulf Gigaproject Supplier Registration — ICE 315 (I:9 C:7 E:5)
**Category:** Project-based lead generation
NEOM, Red Sea Global, Diriyah Gate, Qiddiya all run public supplier-registration portals. Register Divya Stones as approved stone vendor on each. India-UAE CEPA gives duty advantage. One approved-vendor listing = inbound RFQs for years.
- **Owner agent:** tender-hunter
- **Success metric:** Registered on ≥3 portals + 1 RFQ received in 60 days
- **Kill condition:** Registration blocked by requirements we can't meet (log which — that's intel)
- **Why it's different:** Positions at the demand SOURCE, before any importer/distributor margin exists.

## #6 — Dormant Buyer Excavation — ICE 288 (I:8 C:9 E:4)
**Category:** Reactivation
25+ years of invoices, B/Ls, and old emails = hundreds of proven past buyers. Excavate, segment (lapsed/ghosted/ancient), win-back with loyalty pricing. Past buyers convert 5-10× cold leads.
- **Owner agent:** reactivation-specialist
- **Success metric:** 50+ dormant contacts excavated, ≥5 conversations reopened in 3 weeks
- **Kill condition:** Historical data unavailable/unusable (needs user's records — flag and park)
- **Why it's different:** Zero acquisition cost; trust already banked. Blocked only on the user sharing old records.

## #7 — "Virtual Quarry Tour" Live Video Call — ICE 280 (I:7 C:8 E:5)
**Category:** Conversion (trust accelerator)
Offer serious prospects a 20-minute live video call FROM the quarry — see blocks cut, pick their lot section live. Collapses the trust problem ("is this supplier real?") that kills India-sourcing deals. Position as exclusive: "We do 4 slots a month."
- **Owner agent:** sample-converter + sales-coach (call script)
- **Success metric:** 3 tours booked from 20 invitations; ≥1 proceeds to proposal
- **Kill condition:** <1 booking from 20 invites
- **Why it's different:** Competitors send brochures. We hand the buyer a hard hat through the screen.

## #8 — Marmomacc 2026 Visitor Blitz (Sept 22-25) — ICE 252 (I:9 C:7 E:4)
**Category:** Event lead generation — TIME-SENSITIVE
Attend Verona as visitor (no booth cost). 60-day pre-show campaign: mine exhibitor list, LinkedIn "attending Marmomacc" posts, book 25 meetings before landing. EU report says this is THE entry event for Europe.
- **Owner agent:** trade-show-scout
- **Success metric:** ≥20 meetings booked pre-show
- **Kill condition:** N/A (time-boxed by event) — but <10 bookings by Sept 1 = downgrade trip scope
- **Deadline pressure:** Pre-show campaign must start by late July 2026.

## #9 — Freight Forwarder Referral Loop — ICE 240 (I:6 C:8 E:5)
**Category:** Partnership lead generation
CHAs and freight forwarders in Mundra/Chennai see every new stone importer FIRST (they clear the containers). Offer 2% referral on first order for introductions to new green-marble importers. 5 forwarder relationships = permanent early-warning radar.
- **Owner agent:** partnership-builder
- **Success metric:** 5 forwarders agreed + 2 introductions in 45 days
- **Kill condition:** 0 introductions in 60 days despite agreements
- **Why it's different:** Buys the industry's best-positioned eyes for a success-only fee.

## #10 — LinkedIn "Build in Public" Quarry Series — ICE 216 (I:6 C:6 E:6)
**Category:** Inbound (authority compounding)
Weekly raw quarry content: block extraction, lot grading decisions, container loading, "what went wrong this week." B2B buyers follow REAL operations. Over 6 months, becomes the most-followed green marble page — inbound DMs replace outbound begging.
- **Owner agent:** social-media-manager
- **Success metric:** +500 targeted followers + 5 inbound DMs in 90 days
- **Kill condition:** <50 followers/month growth after 8 consistent weeks
- **Why it's different:** Every competitor posts polished catalog shots. Raw process content is the gap.
